sources.title: Paytm lays off over 1,000 employees, impacting 10% of its headcount: Report - BusinessToday
sources.description: The layoffs at Paytm are likely to affect at least 10 per cent of the overall headcount, and is believed to be among the steepest job cuts by an Indian new-age tech firm this year.

sources.title: AI is here for your jobs: Paytm lays off 1,000 workers amid automation push
sources.description: In 2021, Paytm had let 500 to 700 employees go based on non-performance.
